>
> -Dave

messages.body_plain:
I know this is an old post, can you tell me what you mean by

"# then you need to have some calibration reference to convert it in dB SPL"?

On Monday, July 19, 2010 at 4:21:04 AM UTC-4, Jerome Sueur wrote:
> Dear Dave,
>
> o To get the average amplitude:
> # first read your sample with readWave()
> library(seewave)
> library(tuneR)
> a <- readWave("dave.wav")
> # then you can compute the root-mean-square of the absolute values of
> your sample (ie the absolute envelope)
> amp <- rms(abs(a@left))
> # then you need to have some calibration reference to convert it in dB SPL
>
> o I don't understand exactly what you mean by average frequency, but
> here is the way to get the average spectrum of your sample
> freq <- meanspec(a)
> # you can get the maximum peak or more using fpeaks():
> fpeaks(freq)
>
> HTH
>
> Best
>
> Jerome
